name: Natsuiro Mikan ~Ecchi na Shoujo to Shitataru Nioi~
original_name: 夏色蜜汗 ～えっちな少女としたたる匂い～
source: In Natsuiro Mikan, join Kouhei on his journey to recover his memories. As he travels to his hometown in search of his missing memories, he finds it deserted save for a lone young girl. Enticed by each other’s presence, the two begin to enjoy their hot and sultry summer full of new experiences and the sweet sweat of intermingling bodies.
translation: 在《夏色蜜汗》中，跟随公平踏上找回记忆的旅程。他为了寻找失去的记忆回到故乡，却发现那里空无一人，只有一名年轻女孩留在那里。两人被彼此的存在吸引，开始享受这段充满新体验、交融身体的甜蜜汗水与炽热诱人的夏日时光。
